prompt:
Use case: photorealistic Hanzi learning photographs for 轮 (actual rolling vehicle wheels), three exact existing contexts in order.
Primary request: one 1024x1792 vertical triptych made of three independent horizontal landscape photographs stacked top to bottom, equal-height panels separated only by two thin straight white horizontal seams near y=597 and y=1195. No outer border, text or image labels.
Top photo — 自行车的轮: one complete bicycle front rolling wheel attached to its fork and axle, thin real black rubber tire, silver metal rim and radial spokes, wheel resting on an outdoor paved path; just enough cropped bicycle fork/frame above to establish context, but the entire circular tire and hub remain fully inside the photo. Side-on camera, visible tire ground contact.
Middle photo — 汽车的轮: one complete car rolling wheel mounted under a real car wheel arch, black treaded rubber tire and plain unbranded metal alloy rim with an unmarked central hub, tire touching outdoor pavement; a small portion of neutral car body establishes the context, the entire tire circumference visible. Side-on camera, no writing on tire sidewall.
Bottom photo — 手推车的轮: one complete rolling wheel on a practical hand-pushed utility cart, real rubber tire and simple metal hub attached to a visible horizontal axle beneath part of a plain wooden or metal cart platform, tire touching a courtyard path; enough cart structure to establish context, whole circular rolling wheel centered. Side-on camera, no steering mechanism.
Style and lighting: genuine documentary-quality close-up photographs, authentic rubber tread, metal, spoke reflections and ordinary material wear, natural daylight, realistic grounded shadows, not CGI or illustration.
Composition: each actual rolling wheel is centered wholly inside its own landscape panel with generous clearance around the entire circular tire and from all seams; vehicle bodies may extend beyond the background frame but wheels must never be cropped, all three wheels crop-safe.
Constraints: rolling wheels attached to real vehicle axles only, absolutely no steering wheel, ship helm, toy wheel or standalone decorative circle. No readable writing, letters, tire numbers, captions, logos, brands, watermarks, cartoons, decorative graphics, people or hands. Only the bicycle, car and handcart wheel contexts, in the exact stated top-to-bottom order.
reviewNotes: 300x525 JPEG reviewed: bicycle wheel with spokes/fork, car tire with alloy rim under wheel arch, rubber utility-cart wheel beneath wooden platform, correctly ordered and grounded; real rolling wheels, no steering wheels or visible writing/logos. Car tire is close to the upper seam, so inset 4 preserves its circumference while removing white separators. Sharp RGB measured full-width white rows 592–596 and 1189–1193, center cuts 594/1191.
